definitions.explanation: Having no physical form or shape. Often used in formal, legal, and cultural contexts to distinguish non-physical assets, heritage, or value from tangible ones.

examples.japanese: {無形|むけい}⟦{文化|ぶんか}{財|ざい}→文化財：12932_bunkazai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{指定|してい}→指定：00373_shitei⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: It was designated as an intangible cultural property.

examples.japanese: ⟦{信頼|しんらい}→信頼：03268_shinrai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{企業|きぎょう}→企業：00225_kigyou⟧⟦にとって→にとって：06803_nitotte⟧⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧{無形|むけい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{資産|しさん}→資産：15655_shisan⟧⟦である→である：09855_dearu⟧。
examples.english: Trust is a significant intangible asset for a company.

examples.japanese: ユネスコ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{無形|むけい}⟦{文化|ぶんか}{遺産|いさん}→文化遺産：17353_bunkaisan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{登録|とうろく}→登録：05703_touroku⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧ことで、⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{伝統|でんとう}{芸能|げいのう}→伝統芸能：15098_dentougeinou⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{関心|かんしん}→関心：00182_kanshin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{世界的|せかいてき}→世界的：20935_sekaiteki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{高|たか}まった→高まる：02066_takamaru⟧。
examples.english: Its registration as a UNESCO Intangible Cultural Heritage raised worldwide interest in this traditional performing art.

notes:
USAGE:
Used as a noun or ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧-adjective ({無形|むけい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧). Most commonly encountered in the compound {無形|むけい}⟦{文化|ぶんか}{財|ざい}→文化財：12932_bunkazai⟧ (intangible cultural property) and {無形|むけい}⟦{文化|ぶんか}{遺産|いさん}→文化遺産：17353_bunkaisan⟧ (intangible cultural heritage). Also used in business for intangible assets. The antonym is ⟦{有形|ゆうけい}→有形：13079_yuukei⟧ (tangible).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {無形|むけい}⟦{文化|ぶんか}{財|ざい}→文化財：12932_bunkazai⟧ (intangible cultural property)
- {無形|むけい}⟦{文化|ぶんか}{遺産|いさん}→文化遺産：17353_bunkaisan⟧ (intangible cultural heritage)
- {無形|むけい}⟦{資産|しさん}→資産：15655_shisan⟧ (intangible assets)
- {無形|むけい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{力|ちから}→力：01661_chikara⟧ (intangible power/force)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{有形|ゆうけい}→有形：13079_yuukei⟧: tangible, having physical form (antonym)
- ⟦{形|かたち}→形：02193_katachi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧: formless, shapeless (more casual expression)
- ⟦{抽象的|ちゅうしょうてき}→抽象的：04782_chuushouteki⟧: abstract (conceptual rather than concrete)
